backfillRows.why: THE SECOND CARRIER. An apparition reaches the sheet through this option's own copy of the prose (build.ts:8245 pushes option.description into character.classChoices, which FeatsTab renders), not through classFeatures/<id> — so the eleven classFeatures rows above repair a record the player's apparition card never reads. AoN apparition-3, apparition-4, apparition-5, apparition-6, apparition-7, apparition-8, apparition-9, apparition-10, apparition-11, apparition-12, apparition-13 print the damage type on each avatar Strike ("**Damage** 6d10+6 bludgeoning plus Grab", apparition-7); the same insertion is applied here. Supersedes the existing scripts/data/effect-backfill.json row for classes/animist.options [extraChoices, id=apparition] (wg-batch-028's loreProgression array, which also created lamentation-of-sinister-deals): this value IS that row's array, byte-for-byte, with only the eleven descriptions re-typed — every other field of every one of the fourteen options is carried whole.

findings.note: The @Damage cleaner kept the dice and ate the TYPE on 10 of the 14 animist apparitions' avatar Strikes, so "6d10+6 bludgeoning" shipped as "6d10+6". scripts/repair-damage-type.mjs re-derives each type from the record's own AoN document (apparition-3…apparition-12) and splices it in after the dice — insertions only, never a replacement of our prose with the mirror's. 1 record(s) refused (spells/devil-form: the Archives roll 2d12+10 where we roll 2d10+10 at site 5, so its sites cannot be paired — a separate defect, reported as a cross-file gap). Verifier: a twelfth row re-emits classes/animist.options[extraChoices,id=apparition] whole, because the option keeps its OWN copy of the prose and that copy is what the sheet renders.
